title: loan.created.v1
description: A book was lent: the copy is reserved in the inventory and the loan is stored with its due date. Published by the library backend once the loan is saved.
x-transport: Amazon EventBridge: `source` is x-source, `detail-type` is the event name, `detail` is this payload.

startedAt.description: When the loan started, ISO 8601 with timezone.

dueAt.description: When the book must be returned, ISO 8601 with timezone (from @acme/domain).
